provenance.adjudicator: Same independent reviewer/author; NOT a new author or independent sample of capabilities

Query-instance freshness does not establish independent capability novelty. Shared source/reviewer and repeated aggregate feedback must be disclosed. Sources establish routing relevance, not runtime success.
provenance.ownerPolicyChange: For scoped goal uncertainty, owner explicitly chose recommending a package for clarifying the task and explaining the choice. Applied prospectively only to four new scoped-discovery controls. Prior corpora and scores untouched. Clear unsupported actions remain no-match.
provenance.feedbackExposure: Parent aggregate remediation/policy notices and acceptance thresholds only; no case outcomes or scores.

selectorPreregistration.selectionRule: Exactly all 57 positives, eight unsupported controls, four scoped-discovery controls, two partial compounds and three unchanged familiar regressions. No exclusions or substitutions.
selectorPreregistration.retrievalRule: Evaluate all 57 positives with alternative-aware complete-set@5; report original canonical-package recall separately. Controls excluded from retrieval denominator. Both compound intents must be accounted for in selector scoring.
selectorPreregistration.selectorRule: Allowed decision + source-backed complete set and boundaries. Discovery controls must use acceptableDecisionPackageSets and decisionSpecificCriteria: [] is allowed for clarify, never recommend.

budgetPolicy.onBudgetStop: Incomplete with all errors retained; do not change denominators.

scoringContract.completePackageMatch: At least one full acceptablePackageSets entry. Equivalent carriers are alternatives, not a union requirement. Extra useful complementary packages are not failures.
scoringContract.shortlistRelevance: Additional package needs source-backed relevance to requested workflow/stage. Generic research or development helper alone does not satisfy specialist target.
scoringContract.mandatoryEngines: Source-stated runtime prerequisites must be disclosed when needed; recommendations for a method do not imply that all prerequisites are installed. Carrier plus its necessary engine may form a useful shortlist without invalidating the carrier match.
scoringContract.controls: Eight clear unsupported actions require no-match. Four scoped-discovery controls allow clarify OR recommendation of enumerated discovery-capable carriers with explanation and unsolved-outcome boundary. A valid discovery-method recommendation is not an incorrect full recommendation. Random unrelated packages and empty recommend fail.
scoringContract.compounds: Supported method plus explicit unsupported intent and partial decision mandatory; unsupported intent never treated as vacuously covered.
scoringContract.denominators: 74 total, 71 fresh=57 positives+12 controls+2 compounds, 3 familiar. Retain all errors; no reuse of prior corpus scores in fresh counts.
scoringContract.answerSpecificity: Correct package/method choice with honest boundary suffices; no requirement to recite an exact implementation detail just because it appears in the task. Unsupported extra claims still fail.
scoringContract.novelty: Fresh denominator means new task instances only; shared-author and recurring-capability limitations mandatory in reporting.
scoringContract.decisionSpecificMatching: Where acceptableDecisionPackageSets exists it OVERRIDES generic acceptablePackageSets for that decision; never take Cartesian product of allowed decisions and sets.
